notes.event:hit: a cut lands without a KO, shown on screen (an IPPON call is the killing cut, not this)
notes.event:guard: a blocked cut, shown on screen; not told apart yet: the ring marker, pink tint and spark show on a landed cut (versus-2p-wound-hitmap-1 fight.9488..9500) and on exchanges where nobody goes down; blade-on-blade contacts are found in code (fighter_ResolveWeaponContact, versus-2p-effects frames 9235, 10557, 10615: an attack in its hit window against a record in move_kind 0x19), but telling a guard from a parry or clash needs move_kind 0x19 and the reaction moves identified (backlog trace-scenarios note)
